objective.definition: Count opened pull requests that replace the temporary managed-tools path with one reviewed session kernel and pass the lifecycle, database-analysis, provider-parity, migration, and repository gates at the PR head.

anti_goals.activation_condition: Any close, cancel, release, or session finalization change
anti_goals.read_method: Assert repeated callers await one settlement and one external teardown

anti_goals.activation_condition: Session, streaming, provider, or sandbox shutdown changes
anti_goals.read_method: Close during model and database work, then assert every child settles before dependencies close
Force missing binding, unreachable backend, or validation engine failure and assert model calls remain zero
Compare advertised and dispatched resource identities for every round

anti_goals.activation_condition: Roots, tenant policy, process, database, sandbox, or provider authority changes
anti_goals.read_method: Replay fail-closed authority cases and audit provider arguments
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Denied-root, cross-tenant, read-only, and missing-policy tests

anti_goals.activation_condition: Tool, agent, session, validation, provider, or backend wiring changes
anti_goals.read_method: Resolve every public composition with one required binding removed
Require model, tool, subagent, sandbox, database, and apply effects through declared flow or resource edges

anti_goals.activation_condition: Any logic or integration test changes
anti_goals.read_method: Reject internal reaches, module mocks, and global patches outside adapter tests

anti_goals.activation_condition: Any public SDK or provider change
anti_goals.read_method: Assert no MCP package, automatic tag scan, native Claude tool, or automatic collection surface
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Changed-path, dependency, and public export audit

anti_goals.activation_condition: Any public SDK or Lite API change
anti_goals.read_method: Compare public declarations against main and classify every difference as preserved, bridged, or intentionally changed
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Type contracts, packed exports, changeset, and migration guide

anti_goals.read_method: Compare baseline and candidate chain plus diamond lifecycle cases with a predeclared tolerance
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Focused resource resolution and cleanup benchmark

anti_goals.read_method: Run every touched package test, typecheck, build, lint, and repository gate
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Focused package gates, root verify, root lint, and baseline comparison

anti_goals.read_method: Work in a new isolated worktree from main and preserve the dirty main checkout
Reject weakened, stale, unsupported, superficial, or self-certified claims
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Append-only run store and deterministic validators

anti_goals.activation_condition: Any DKR, design, readiness, or completion acceptance
anti_goals.read_method: Require a separate reviewer plus executable evidence for every judgement-heavy acceptance
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Claude review, adversarial challenger records, and deterministic replay

anti_goals.read_method: Reject implementation before lifecycle and session DKRs are accepted
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Run tree and accepted checkpoint references

anti_goals.activation_condition: Important evidence or run records are read or written
anti_goals.read_method: Use the store helper or record target plus content hash and verify the store
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Content hashes, append-only records, and store verification

anti_goals.activation_condition: Any resource, session, provider, sandbox, or database lifecycle change
anti_goals.read_method: Replay close, release, cancellation, failure, and shared-lifetime cases; count lifecycle operations that touch a dependency after that dependency closes
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Lifecycle conformance tests and ordered teardown traces

anti_goals.activation_condition: Any lifecycle callback, context close, resource cleanup, session finish, checkpoint, or seal change
anti_goals.read_method: Audit lifecycle callbacks and traces; count checkpoint, persistence, sealing, model, database, filesystem, sandbox, or scheduler business effects outside named flows
anti_goals.source_of_truth: Graph traces, lifecycle callback audit, and explicit finishSession tests

allowed: Read and probe Lite, SDK, provider, example, and prior OKRA behavior
Create one isolated worktree and successor branch from current main
Edit pkg/core/lite only after an accepted lifecycle DKR proves a reusable invariant
Edit SDK core, providers, focused examples, tests, docs, manifests, lockfile, and changesets required by the accepted design
Use installed Claude CLI for independent architecture and final review
Commit, push, open the successor PR, then close the superseded managed-tools PR with a trace link
approval_gates: Only the human may change the frame, metrics, thresholds, action envelope, release scope, or merge decision
A Lite core change requires an accepted DKR and independent review
Privileged database apply remains outside this PR
forbidden: Publish packages, cut releases, merge the PR, or deploy
Add MCP, automatic tool collection, native Claude tools, or implicit authority
Change lifecycle semantics before accepted discovery
Hold a database transaction or borrowed client across model reasoning turns
Let model output authorize DDL or another privileged apply
Force push, destructive reset, delete evidence, or overwrite the dirty main worktree
Perform unrelated lint or repository cleanup
action_envelope.rollback: Keep work in narrow commits on the isolated successor branch; preserve main and both predecessor branches

human_confirmation_boundary.amendment: Retire dependent_cleanup_after_dependency_count; add dependency_use_after_dependency_close_count == 0 and business_effect_in_lifecycle_hook_count == 0; retain empirical lifecycle evidence and supersede the earlier thin-session conclusion.
human_confirmation_boundary.evidence: User: lets resume the /goal, accumulate the learning to steer the details

assignment: Create artifacts/dkr-provider-capability-matrix.md and replay/dkr-provider-capabilities.sh. Inspect current Claude, Codex, and pi-ai adapters and existing tests. Build a deterministic source/test probe that classifies each required capability as native, fallback, unsupported, or implementation-required with exact evidence. Prove whether root pre-resolution can let two session contexts reuse each boundary-owned provider resource without session A cleanup killing session B; if current public exports prevent the probe, record the exact implementation requirement. Preserve model/complete compatibility. MCP and native Claude tool integration remain out of scope. Do not edit product or package files and do not make paid provider calls.

budget_and_stop_rule.stop: Stop with a replayable provider matrix and exact first-PR adapter requirements, or hand back one capability that cannot be classified from source and deterministic tests.

hand_back_rule: Do not infer native support from protocol names. Mark unknown or implementation-required when evidence is absent. Do not broaden into MCP.

output_schema.matrix: Markdown capability table with file:line evidence and migration requirements
output_schema.probe: Saved deterministic shell replay under replay/
output_schema.result: Commands, exit codes, hashes, gaps, no self-acceptance
